{
  "name": "quillfolio",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "private": true,
  "description": "QuillFolio: an original open-source PDF app for viewing, editing, forms, signing, OCR and repair, with a complete, customizable command library.",
  "license": "MIT",
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "vite",
    "prebuild": "node scripts/gen-notices.mjs && node scripts/copy-pdfjs.mjs",
    "build": "vite build",
    "preview": "vite preview",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "test": "vitest run",
    "e2e": "node tests/e2e/smoke.mjs",
    "catalog": "vite-node scripts/gen-catalog.ts",
    "notices": "node scripts/gen-notices.mjs",
    "cap:sync": "npx cap sync android",
    "android:build": "npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease",
    "ios:sync": "npm run build && npx cap sync ios",
    "desktop": "npm run build && node scripts/prepare-desktop.mjs && electron build/desktop-app",
    "desktop:dist": "npm run build && node scripts/prepare-desktop.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs",
    "icons": "node scripts/gen-android-icons.mjs && node scripts/gen-platform-icons.mjs",
    "predev": "node scripts/copy-pdfjs.mjs",
    "pretest": "node scripts/copy-pdfjs.mjs"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@capacitor/android": "^8.5.3",
    "@capacitor/app": "^8.1.2",
    "@capacitor/core": "^8.5.3",
    "@capacitor/filesystem": "^8.1.5",
    "@capacitor/ios": "^8.5.3",
    "@capacitor/share": "^8.0.3",
    "@fontsource/arimo": "^5.3.0",
    "@fontsource/caladea": "^5.3.0",
    "@fontsource/carlito": "^5.3.0",
    "@fontsource/courier-prime": "^5.3.0",
    "@fontsource/cousine": "^5.3.0",
    "@fontsource/eb-garamond": "^5.3.0",
    "@fontsource/gelasio": "^5.3.0",
    "@fontsource/lato": "^5.3.0",
    "@fontsource/libre-baskerville": "^5.3.0",
    "@fontsource/merriweather": "^5.3.0",
    "@fontsource/open-sans": "^5.3.0",
    "@fontsource/tinos": "^5.3.0",
    "dictionary-en": "^4.0.0",
    "dictionary-en-au": "^3.0.0",
    "dictionary-en-ca": "^3.0.0",
    "dictionary-en-gb": "^3.0.0",
    "hunspell-asm": "^4.0.2",
    "jszip": "^3.10.2",
    "material-symbols": "^0.48.0",
    "nspell": "^2.1.5",
    "pdfjs-dist": "^6.4.299",
    "tesseract.js": "^7.0.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@capacitor/cli": "^8.5.3",
    "@types/nspell": "^2.1.6",
    "electron": "^43.7.7",
    "electron-builder": "^26.17.0",
    "jsdom": "^29.1.1",
    "playwright": "^1.64.1",
    "typescript": "^5.9.3",
    "vite": "^8.3.4",
    "vite-node": "^6.0.0",
    "vitest": "^5.0.5"
  }
}
